defense_news.title: US Special Operations adopts new half-mask and goggles
defense_news.summary: Avon Protection's MITR half-mask and goggle system is designed to protect wearers from dangerous chemicals and toxic substances in the atmosphere.

defense_news.title: What is Starshield, SpaceX’s military version of Starlink?
defense_news.summary: Ukraine said on Wednesday that SpaceX had restricted “military-grade” Starlink services, hampering Ukrainian drone strike missions and air defenses.

defense_news.title: US Army’s 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated
defense_news.summary: The Army's 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated as the service reshapes its PSYOP and information warfare forces to counter global adversaries.
